The apartment features a living area with glossy tiled flooring and large windows, creating a bright space suitable for flexible seating and dining arrangements. A recessed counter between the living area and kitchenette adds a functional breakfast bar or serving zone. The primary bedroom offers built-in mirrored wardrobes, balcony access, and a simple layout that supports various furniture placements. 
The kitchen provides black lower cabinetry, a built-in oven with range hood, refrigerator, washing machine, and stainless-steel sink, organized for efficient daily use. Bathrooms include a double-sink vanity with a large mirror, bathtub with shower, toilet, bidet, and a second bathroom with a modern vanity and mosaic tile accents. The tiled finishes and recessed lighting contribute to a clean and easy-to-maintain environment. 
Balcony access from the living space and bedroom opens to glass-railed outdoor areas with marina and city views. From this vantage point, residents can observe the water, nearby mosque, and developing skyline, with good natural light throughout the day. The high-floor position enhances privacy and minimizes street-level noise. 
Residents of DAMAC Heights benefit from building amenities including a swimming pool, gym or health club, jacuzzi, sauna, children’s play facilities, lobby with reception, and 24-hour concierge and security with CCTV. The tower also offers landscaped areas, a barbeque area, on-site café, business center, and pet-friendly policies, adding convenience for daily living. 
Located in Dubai Marina, the tower sits within a well-connected waterfront community close to shopping malls, schools, medical facilities, and public transport links such as tram and metro connections. The area provides access to beaches, dining, leisure venues, and major road networks, supporting a practical lifestyle with both marina and downtown city amenities within easy reach.
